zone_name: OMR and ECR corridor, south Chennai

hub.name: Sholinganallur
hub.rationale: Sholinganallur is the only candidate that is central to the corridor geometry, the OMR rail line boundary and the GCC free-supply network. Mean distance from the 50 localities to Sholinganallur is 6.5 km; to Navalur it would be 9.4 km and to Thiruvanmiyur 8.7 km, and both of those sit at one end of the long thin ECR leg rather than at its centre. Sholinganallur also carries the GCC Animal Birth Control Centre at Div 199 Zone XV, so the cold-chain base and the free-supply referral point sit on the same street, and it is the widest-spread apartment stock in the zone with ELCOT, the Infosys campus township and RMZ Ecoworld within a 3 km radius.
